# Phase 4 — UI Design Contract

> Visual and interaction contract for frontend phases. Generated by gsd-ui-researcher, verified by gsd-ui-checker.

**Scope note:** This phase adds the steward's month export: a month picker, a staged file and a refusal dialog for months over the cap. Every token and spacing step is inherited from earlier phases.

**Accent (`--primary`) reserved for:**

**Destructive (`--destructive`) reserved for:**
1. The refusal dialog's icon
2. A failed export's badge

---

## Export Action Contract

### Month picker

A native month input with the current month preselected.

### One button, two outcomes

Under the cap the file starts at once; over it the refusal dialog opens instead.

---

## Cap Refusal Dialog

States the month, the number of loans found and the 5,000 cap, then offers `Pick another month`. It never shows a number it did not receive.

---

## Export Row Contract

### Row anatomy and states

Summary and action on the first line, the current stage on the second, a bar and readout on the third.

### Skipped-loan note

A finished export lists any loans it left out, with their IDs.

---

## Copywriting Contract

| Element | Copy |
|---------|------|
| Main action | **"Export month"** |
| Refusal title | **"That month holds {N} loans. The cap is 5,000."** |
| Empty history | **"No exports yet"** |

---

## Accessibility & Interaction

- The picker has a visible label and keeps focus after a refusal.
- A finished export is announced once, politely.

---

## UI Considerations

Applicable state considerations resolved: **25 explicit, 5 backstop, 0 unresolved** across E1 month picker and button, E2 refusal dialog, E3 export row and E4 skipped-loan note.

| Category | Element(s) | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|------------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | E1 month picker | ✅ covered | A month with no loans still exports an empty file with headers. |
| loading | E1 month picker | ✅ covered | The button disables while the count is checked. |
| error | E1 month picker | ✅ covered | A failed count shows an alert and keeps the picked month. |
| populated | E1 month picker | ✅ covered | Picker and button sit on one line. |
| partial | E1 month picker | ✅ covered | A cleared picker disables the button. |
| overflow | E1 month picker | 🧪 backstop | At 390px the picker and button wrap without page overflow. |
| zero-one-many | E1 month picker | ✅ covered | The count label reads "1 loan" and "N loans". |
| long-text | E1 month picker | ✅ covered | The row holds no user text. |
| empty | E2 refusal dialog | ✅ covered | Opens only for a concrete refusal. |
| loading | E2 refusal dialog | ✅ covered | The check finishes before the dialog opens. |
| error | E2 refusal dialog | ✅ covered | A timeout shows copy with no number. |
| populated | E2 refusal dialog | ✅ covered | Month, found count and cap all show. |
| overflow | E2 refusal dialog | 🧪 backstop | On a short screen the footer stays reachable. |
| zero-one-many | E2 refusal dialog | ✅ covered | The count uses a grouped number. |
| empty | E3 export row | ✅ covered | With no exports the page shows its empty copy. |
| loading | E3 export row | ✅ covered | Queued, known-length and unknown-length bars are distinct. |
| error | E3 export row | ✅ covered | A failed row keeps a retry button. |
| populated | E3 export row | ✅ covered | Summary, stage, bar and one action. |
| partial | E3 export row | ✅ covered | An export with skipped loans stays downloadable. |
| overflow | E3 export row | 🧪 backstop | At 390px the summary and action wrap without clipping. |
| zero-one-many | E3 export row | ✅ covered | The loan count reads "1 loan". |
| long-text | E3 export row | 🧪 backstop | A 300-character stage text must not widen the page. |
| empty | E4 skipped-loan note | ✅ covered | Zero skipped renders nothing. |
| loading | E4 skipped-loan note | ✅ covered | The region is reserved while the list opens. |
| error | E4 skipped-loan note | ✅ covered | The known count stays with a retry. |
| populated | E4 skipped-loan note | ✅ covered | Exact IDs in a bounded list. |
| partial | E4 skipped-loan note | ✅ covered | A partial list keeps every returned ID and the full count. |
| overflow | E4 skipped-loan note | ✅ covered | The list scrolls at 240px. |
| zero-one-many | E4 skipped-loan note | ✅ covered | "1 loan skipped" and "N loans skipped". |
| long-text | E4 skipped-loan note | 🧪 backstop | Long IDs wrap or ellipsize without overflow. |
